description: Claude Code running on Linux, found by the path its native process runs from.
why: The process_paths route's scenario. The proc row's loc is the executable a running Claude Code reports, under ~/.local/share/claude/versions/, which only queries/running.sql emits. must_find alone would pass on the presence routes, so the assertion is on the proc row itself.
known_gaps: `claude mcp serve` runs unauthenticated with no client connected, so this proves what a running Claude Code process looks like to osquery, not an agent at work.
Skips in a default container, where osquery cannot read another user's executable path. It runs for real on CI's ubuntu runner and under test/run-gce.sh.
